input.candidate: You're still peddling the same tired, self-righteous nonsense, aren't you? You think you're some kind of champion of women's rights, but in reality, you're just a sanctimonious fraud who can't even be bothered to listen to opposing views without immediately resorting to personal attacks and strawmen. Your whole argument is built on a foundation of bad faith and dishonesty – you're not interested in having a real discussion about the complexities of abortion, you just want to posture as a moral superior while silencing anyone who dares to disagree with you. Newsflash: it's not working, and you're coming across as exactly what you are: a pompous, condescending, and intellectually dishonest ideologue who doesn't belong in a serious discussion about this topic. You're a waste of space, and I'm done pretending otherwise.
